method: Fetched rendered HTML for both demo pages from the Pig dev server (http://localhost:3100, curl via wsl-run.sh). Extracted every factual claim (business identity, services, areas served, hours, credentials, contact details, provenance/footer statements, media rights statements). Traced each claim to the PING projection JSON (/home/nolan/ping/var/fyd-projections/<site>.json: object graph + provenance refs), the media manifests (src/fyd/media/manifests/), and the generator/renderer source. Checked src/fyd/sitespec/binding-verifier.ts and its call graph for coverage.
note_on_verifier: BindingVerifier verdicts were NOT available for these pages: verifyBinding/buildVerifiedRenderModel/assertSpecBindingsVerified are called only from src/fyd/builder/planner.ts planSite (used by /build/[siteId]). The audited pages (src/app/sites/coppersmith-plumbing/page.tsx, src/app/sites/happy-place/page.tsx) call generateSiteSpec from src/fyd/proceduralize/generator.ts directly and never build a VerifiedRenderModel. The verifier therefore misses 100 percent of claims on /sites pages by construction. Every classification below was done by manual evidence tracing.
root_causes: R-A: The /sites demo render path bypasses the verification seam. generateSiteSpec never calls buildVerifiedRenderModel; the fail-closed emission gate exists only on the /build planner path. Any factual string on a /sites page is unverified by design, not by accident.

R-B: Renderer-injected factual strings live outside the PresentationBinding model. The footer provenance line (site-client.tsx:169), the rights-basis EvidenceStep (renderer.tsx:1673), and the 'Verified from' wording (contact-link.tsx:56-78) are composed in components, so even a verifier-invoking path would not classify them.

R-C: Evidence-state to UI-wording mappings overclaim. 'observed' is rendered as 'Verified' (contact-link.tsx), and a heuristic rights inference is labeled state 'observed' (renderer.tsx:1673). The wording layer upgrades epistemic strength without evidence.
